title: Teaching Students Effects of Problem Gambling
what_it_is: Teaching Students Effects of Problem Gambling

sections.label: School support for problem gambling
sections.summary: Teachers refer students with gambling problems to counsellors trained by the National Addictions Management Service, with complex cases referred to the Institute of Mental Health.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Teachers who are aware of students facing problem gambling personally or at home will refer them to the school counsellors.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Our school counsellors are trained by the National Addictions Management Service which is supported by the Ministry of Health.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: For more complex cases, schools will refer the students to mental health professionals from the Institute of Mental Health.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Our schools also benefit from outreach programmes and roadshows mounted by external agencies, such as the National Council on Problem Gambling and Touch Cyber Wellness, provided to promote awareness of problem gambling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: My second question is: in 2012, the then-Minister for Education said that MOE was developing a core CCE syllabus where key elements of problem gambling awareness and prevention programmes would be given due emphasis in the new syllabus.

sections.label: CCE and Cyber Wellness programmes
sections.summary: The CCE and Cyber Wellness programmes reach students on gambling, online gambling and other addictive behaviour through different modules at different stages.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my answer earlier, the CCE programme, as well as the Cyber Wellness programme, has been able to reach out to our students not only about gambling or online gambling, but also in other aspects of addictive behaviour.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The Member is right to say that we have enhanced our CCE over the years.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We have been able to reach out to students not only via one module but different modules at different stages.

sections.label: Shared responsibility beyond teachers
sections.summary: The system is embedded as the responsibility not only of teachers but also of peers, society and school counsellors.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: At the same time, we want to ensure that this whole system is embedded not only as the responsibility of the teachers but also their peers, as well as the whole society.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, when the Member mentioned about teachers already having a heavy workload, it is not being undertaken by the teachers alone, but also by the school counsellors.
